acceptance.gate: Phase 3 gate G3 per master-plan v2.1 §9: partitioned-vs-monolithic differences at finest level at Coreform level (p=2 <= 3.3e-6 per plan). NOTE: the prose (§6) does not state the calibrated CTest tolerance numerically; it only says the study-level CTest takes the maximum of the six quantities at the finest level and enforces a calibrated tolerance. The 3.3e-6 figure is from the master plan, not verified against the study CTest definition file (not present in the crawled sources).

boundary_conditions.clamp: z=0 end face pinned in all three translational directions
boundary_conditions.note: No density/body force; bending and transverse shear exercised by end traction only.

geometry.note_partitions: Six partition patterns: bottom-centered 1/3 square, bottom-left 1/2 square, centered 1/3 square, zig-zag (equal-area, non-collinear planes), nested-L, Tetris (3x3, two 4-square L cells + central 1-square cell; three materials meet at central corners). Each internal boundary extruded through full beam length.
geometry.units_note: Unit system not stated in §2-§4. Magnitudes (E = 100e9, traction ty = 10.0e-3, resultant P = 1) are consistent with SI (m, Pa, N), but this is NOT asserted: record as unknown pending the Abaqus journal files.

loads.target: every cell face at z=L, -y direction; same traction applied to full partitioned end face

materials.note: Distinct Abaqus material/section definitions per cell (2 for first five cases, 3 for Tetris) with IDENTICAL properties, so internal boundaries are physically invisible in the continuum problem.

mesh_sweep.discretization: same immersed rectilinear background grid, outer geometry, grid origin and h/p coordinates for every model; only retained cell topology differs

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §2 Geometry (Table 1, Fig.1), §3 Material (Table 2), §4 Loading & BC (Table 3), §6 Reference & accepted solutions, §7 Results

reference_values.monolithic_reference_model: same-h, same-p monolithic beam (identical degree, refinement, grid placement, loading, material); Euler-Bernoulli cantilever recorded as secondary record-only diagnostic, NOT used for the invariance judgment
reference_values.note: Values above are the measured-vs-monolithic relative differences at (p=2, level=3, h=1.25) for the Tetris partition, the most demanding topology. Coarse-level differences are O(1e-1) and converge to O(1e-6) at the finest level.
